name: secure-sdlc
description: Entry point for the ai-security-sdlc toolkit: SDLC orientation and secure agent setup with starter templates and opt-in hooks (security-guidance), the shared app security profile, an index-routed security-standards knowledge corpus, intent-to-spec-to-plan security planning with CodeGuard-backed Secure Build Plans, and remediation that closes findings back into standards and plans, plus a pattern for business-logic hooks at the pre-tool-call layer whose first rule, the mcp-install gate, asks the user for consent before an agent installs an MCP server, and an install-hooks skill that wires it into Codex, Cursor, Copilot and Gemini.
